document_analysis.structure: P1 separates hoped-for memory benefit from missing baseline; P2 describes a simpler actual benefit and imperfect adherence; P3 gives value, limits and future intention. This progression works. R1 and R2 refine only the middle paragraph.
document_analysis.reasoning_specificity: All nine grouped source constraints survive, but R1 makes the relation among phone use, liking and missed days clearer; R2 restores the modest comparison already explicit in the source. No actual recall improvement or broader phone-use objective is supported.
document_analysis.voice_consistency: Consistent modest first-person reflection, ordinary contractions and British travelling. The exact synthetic observations are retained; no invented experience or affect is needed.
document_analysis.rhythm_repetition: There are two colons in P2, but that count is not itself a problem. The actual issue is the category preface and the although/either chain. P3's caveats serve different functions and need not be removed for variety.
document_analysis.language_features: The English is otherwise natural. Either has an imperfect antecedent; although may imply a broader unprovided aim. Ordinary words, grammar and careful uncertainty are nondiagnostic.
document_analysis.citations_provenance: No external citation is asserted. The supplied experiment records AI source plus AI rewriting, with no authenticated lived experience. The old result is attached after exact SHA checks, while every paragraph received a new current review with the measurements visible.

findings.interpretation: The loose connective chain can suggest that post-reading checking was another breach and turns a plain source observation into a compensating caveat.
